recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied URL-to-URI correction on current build source without changing compatibility aliases or release-history records. FHIR-48988 should remain a separate unresolved example request.
issue_request: FHIR-45450 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent and requested changing Consent.policyBasis.url back to Consent.policyBasis.uri with datatype uri because policy identifiers such as XACML policy URIs are not always URLs.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3169 and commit 3d1b229bce7a416387e9f5b3de46054e2545d7c8 applied the main element change by renaming Consent.policyBasis.url to Consent.policyBasis.uri and changing the type from url to uri, but left the active parent definition and diagram tooltip saying Reference or URL.
additional_context: FHIR-32817 originally introduced policyBasis with URL wording. source/fhir.ini lists Consent as an active resource and preserves Consent.policyBasis.url as a migration alias to Consent.policyBasis.uri. tools/history/release5/profiles-resources.xml still contains R5 URL history and was not edited. FHIR-48988 is a later Triaged XACML example request and was not final enough to decide. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence records were found.
reconciliation: Changed source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml so the Consent.policyBasis parent definition says Reference or URI instead of Reference or URL, and changed the matching tooltip text in source/consent/consent.svg. The existing child uri element, datatype, and migration aliases were preserved.
source_changes: source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: updated the active Consent.policyBasis parent definition from Reference or URL to Reference or URI.
source/consent/consent.svg: updated the matching checked-in Consent diagram tooltip from Reference or URL to Reference or URI.

related_jiras.note: Introduced Consent.policyBasis with URL wording before FHIR-45450 corrected the child path and datatype to URI.
